The detector walks the repository (eight directories deep, at most 2,000 matching files, never following symbolic links) and skips dependency, build, and test-fixture directories:
is a chart; a directory containing a kustomization file is a kustomization.
Parsers treat contents as untrusted: input over a size limit is skipped, document and nesting depth are bounded, a file with any YAML syntax error yields
declarations (not those of its valid documents), and nothing is evaluated.

Malformed: a valid document followed by a broken one, tab indentation, a NUL byte, unclosed template actions, an unclosed flow sequence. All must produce no findings and no crash.
The detector is quiet by default. Anything that depends on the cluster or on a rendered chart gets no verdict from Offing, which is the honest answer.
A kind removed in different releases for different versions needs several small rules. That cost is accepted so each rule states one checkable fact.
The version translation is a convention of Offing's registry, documented here and used by the detector, the importers, and the rules. It is not a general Kubernetes version scheme.
